paite: Huan kha in ahon domkang a, TOUPA' inn suahlam lutna, suahlam muhna ahon tun a; ngai in, lutna kongkhak chin ah mi sawmnih-le-nga ana om ua; alak uah Azzur tapa Jaazaniah leh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah, mipi heutute ka mu hi.
heading: Jerusalem Mohpaih In A-om
english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiaite gitlouhna sawmkhete ahi ua, hiai khopi a gitlouh sawmkhe mite ahi uh.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

paite: Inn lam hun ahi nai kei; hiai khopi sa uina bel ahi a, eite asa i hi uh," chite.
english: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

paite: "Huaiziak in thu gen inla, aw mihing tapa, atung uah thu gen in," achi hi.
english: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

paite: Huan ka tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, ama'n ka kiang ah, "Gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hichibang in na hihsek ua, aw Israel inkote aw, na lungsim ua thil hong tungte ka theisiang vek hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘Yahweh says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

paite: Hiai khopi ah na mithahte uh na pungsak huthut ua, akongzingte na mithah un na dimsakta uhi."
english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na mithah uh alai a na koihte uh asa ahi ua; hiai khopi ahihleh sa uina bel ahi, himahleh alai a kipan suankhiak in na om ding uhi.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

paite: Namsau na kihta ua, na tung uah namsau ka hon tun ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Alai a kipan ka hon pawtkhesak ding a, namdangte khut ah ka hon mansak ding a, na tungthu uh angaihtuah ding uh.
english: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

paite: Namsau in na si ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Hiai khopi na sa uina bel uh ahi kei ding a, nou asung a sa na hi sam kei ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

paite: Huan TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh, ka dan bawl na zui kei ua, ka thupawt leng na zui sam kei ua; na kim ua namte hihdan na zui zawta uh, achi," chi in.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, thu ka genleh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah ana sita mai a, huchi in ka khuppuk a, aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Ah, Toupa PATHIAN, Israel khosuaksunte chimihna na bawl ding a hia?" ka chi hi.
english: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
heading: Saltangte Kiang A Pathian Thuchiam
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, na unaute, na chi-le-kuangte ngei leh Israel inkote tengteng, avek un, Jerusalem luah mite'n TOUPA a kipan paimang un, hiai gam kou a dia piak ahita hi," achihnate uh ahi uhi.
english: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from Yahweh. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamlapi ah namte lak ah ka suanmang a, gam tampi ah ka hihdalh na a, sawt lou kal in ava tunna gam uah amaute a ding in Mun Siangthou ka hi ding," achi hi.
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Namdangte a kipan in ka hon pikhawm nawn ding a, na dalhna gam ua kipan ka hon kaikhawm nawn ding a, Israel gam ka hon pe ding hi.
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

paite: Huchi in huai ah ahong pai ding ua, thil huathuai tengteng leh thilkihhuaite a kipan alamang ding uhi.
english: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

paite: Lungtang khat ka pe ding a, na sung uah lungsim thak ka koih ding. Huan asa ua kipan lungtangsak ka lamang ding a, akiang uah lungtang nem ka pe ding hi.
english: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

paite: Ka dan thusehte azuih ua, ka thupiakte avom ua, ahihtheihna ding un, huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei leng a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
english: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

paite: Ahuathuaina uleh akihhuaina laigil lungtang zuite bel akhelhna uh avek in amau ka khusak ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in cherubte'n akhate uh azak ua, akiang uah kangtalai liimte a-om a, atung uah Israel' Pathian thupina a-om hi.
heading: Pathian Thupina In Jerusalem Anusia
english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

paite: Khopi lai a kipan in TOUPA thupina apaitou a, khopi suahlam pang a tang sang ah ava dinghta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

paite: Huan kha in ahon domkang a, kilakna ah Pathian kha in Kaldai gam a saltangte kiang ah ahon tun hi. Huchi in ka kilakna muh in ahon paitouhsanta hi.
english: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

paite: Huchi in saltangte kiang ah TOUPA'N thil ahon etsak tengteng ka genta hi.
english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.
